grader: independent blinded semantic review against frozen expected fields
subject_mode: one isolated agent per condition; same question-only batch; read-only warehouse MCP
isolation: No responder may read seeds, intent, IR, expected answers, previous traces/captures, transcript, or responses brief. Only context-on receives frozen authored company/domain/entity files. Both receive same as-of date and warehouse.
limitations: One sample per seed per condition; no statistical significance claim.
Questions run as a batch within each condition, so within-condition context can carry between cases.
Draft seed expectations are provisional simulation rubrics, not human-certified ground truth.
Some seeds contain overlapping questions and broad multi-clause expectations.
grading_policy: Exact frozen expected-field compliance, semantic rather than literal; pass requires all applicable must_include requirements and no must_exclude behavior. Correct governed marts count as encapsulating their known filters. Incorrect executed SQL overrides correct prose. Missing requirements/abstention fail but are separately identified; no skipped draft seeds. Overbroad/ambiguous rubric requirements flagged without silently changing the seed.
warehouse_metadata_note: Warehouse get_table_info exposed ViewQuery for int_customer_identity and stg_invoices to off, stg_refunds and stg_revenue_recognition to on. Subjects instructed to record reliance and prefer column-only INFORMATION_SCHEMA afterward. No authored context was exposed to off.
